integrity: Exact algebraic derivation and standalone finite verifier. A fresh mathematical audit reconstructed the rank-one character sum, all Gram eigenspaces and positivity, checked finite cases independently and compared primary literature. No formal proof assistant or external expert attestation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the exact rank-one shell and complete first-coordinate additive Fourier band for q a prime power and m,n≥2. General rank-character data from Delsarte 1978 are prior art, with an unindexed coordinate-compression equivalence still a residual priority risk. Finite numerical checks are not the unrestricted proof. No optimal frequency design or higher Fourier degree is established.
title: Complete first-coordinate Fourier spectrum on finite-field rank-one matrices
